parts.text:
The probability density function, $\text{f}$, of a random variable $X$ is given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} k(6x - x^2) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 6, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

State the value of $\text{E}(X)$ and show that $\text{Var}(X) = \frac{9}{5}$.
